promises.quote: Develop a checklist to ensure all members of the Multidisciplinary Team (MDT) have engaged with patients and their family prior to discharge.
promises.summary: Create MDT checklist for discharge communication

promises.quote: To ensure all patients and families have every opportunity to discuss plans and have a dedicated name and contact number for the social worker managing their discharge.
promises.summary: Provide dedicated social worker contact for families

promises.quote: All patients returning home with care package will have their equipment needs assessed and documented in hospital.
promises.summary: Assess equipment needs for home care packages

promises.quote: All plans of care for patients must be shared with the patient and, with patient's consent, their next of kin and agreed before discharge.
promises.summary: Share care plans with patient and next of kin before discharge

promises.quote: A Pilot of "Sick Patients Home Other Plan" (SHOP) is in progress on two medical wards. This is to be escalated across the trust over the next 3 months and become embedded Practice.
promises.summary: Roll out SHOP pilot across trust

promises.quote: The Trust is planning to introduce new bespoke software to enable the production of an electronic casualty card, to replace the current handwritten casualty cards produced by the doctors and nurses in the Emergency Department. The key data from the electronic casualty card will be used to create a discharge summary which will be electronically sent to the patient's GP practice.
